player_prompt.intro:
Ikaw so Player {player_id} ed Connect Four.
Say simbolo disc: {symbol}.
Say tabla game ari {num_rows} row tan {num_cols} column.
Say mga player agtake turn na magdrop disc ed saray column (0 to {end_col}).
Say unaan na magconnect (saray angga disc) vertical, horizontal, o diagonal so manalo.
Ed say turn mo, enter mo so numero column ed squared bracket para makagawa action.
Para example: '[col 4]' o '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: Agnanengneng na saray manlalaro so board.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Player {player_id}, Invalido format action. Inesperado format: '[col x]'.

action.dropped_disk: Player {player_id} naiwalan ya disk ({player_symbol}) ed column {col}.

outcome.win: Manalo so {player_id} a manlalako no mantitipon na apatiran!
